tax.text: Suozzi pledges to reduce Long Islanders' tax burden and restore the full federal SALT deduction.
tax.quote: restore the full State and Local Tax (SALT) deduction

debt.text: Suozzi says Social Security's promise must not be broken and pushes to protect and strengthen the program.
debt.quote: We cannot allow the promise of Social Security to be broken.

safety.text: His campaign frames public-safety policy around intervention and prevention reforms.
safety.quote: Bringing down crime through common sense reforms centered on intervention and prevention so that people feel safe.

immigration.text: Suozzi co-chairs a task force seeking bipartisan comprehensive reform that pairs stronger border security with modernized legal immigration.
immigration.quote: This task force will advocate for commonsense, bipartisan compromise to achieve much-needed and long-overdue comprehensive immigration reform.

guns.text: Suozzi backs passing commonsense gun safety legislation, including background checks.
guns.quote: I am anxious to roll up my sleeves and get back to work to ensure the passage of long-overdue commonsense gun safety legislation.

abortion.text: Suozzi says he will fight to defend a woman's right to make her own healthcare decisions.
abortion.quote: Tom will always fight to defend a woman's right to make her own healthcare decisions.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Suozzi said he does not think transgender girls should play in girls' sports.
gender.quote: I don't think biological boys should be playing in girls' sports

health.text: Suozzi co-sponsored a bipartisan bill to extend Affordable Care Act premium subsidies and prevent premium spikes.
health.quote: This bill is a commonsense compromise that prevents devastating premium spikes, in some cases, thousands of dollars a month.

energy.text: Suozzi calls climate change real and says it requires bold solutions.
energy.quote: Climate change is real and requires bold solutions to leave a healthier and more sustainable world behind for future generations.

tax.text: LiPetri supports eliminating taxes on tips, overtime, and Social Security and ending the SALT cap.
tax.quote: Supports eliminating taxes on tips, overtime, and Social Security.

safety.text: During the "Defund the Police" period he was the only Long Island state legislator to vote against all anti-police bills.
safety.quote: Mike was the only state legislator from Long Island to vote against ALL anti-police bills.

immigration.text: He pledges to secure the border and create a merit-based legal immigration system.
immigration.quote: securing our border and implementing a merit-based legal immigration system

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: LiPetri says biological men should not compete in female sports or use female facilities.
gender.quote: Biological men should never compete in female sports or use female locker rooms or bathrooms - it's common sense

health.text: LiPetri frames health care around the patient-doctor relationship rather than insurers and government bureaucrats.
health.quote: restore the bond between patients and their doctors, not insurance companies and bureaucrats
